concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-005 (absence of circular data dependencies / CV integrity) is not linked to any concrete verification artifact. Tasks T005 and T010 mention CV execution and edge‑case unit tests, but no task produces a dedicated report (e.g., a CV‑integrity JSON or log) that demonstrably confirms that no data leakage occurred. Add a task that generates and validates such an artifact, and tag it accordingly.
